title: docs: default record page remedies name the other package's page, not the whole package
body:
Fixes #23553

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The package registry's `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT` remedy already says "compose the deployment without the other package's page". Three sibling texts still told the author (or an AI) to drop the whole package. They now say the same thing as the registry, with no option name, package name or tracker number:

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: the save door's refusal (remedy clause only) | "…stays the default unless the deployment is composed without that package." | "…stays the default unless the deployment is composed without that package's page." |
| `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`: `PageSchema.isDefault` TSDoc | "…or compose the deployment without the package that ships the other." | "…or compose the deployment without the other package's page." |
| `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: source comment | "…or composing the deployment without the other package." | "…or composing the deployment without the other package's page." |

The save door's pin (`packages/objectql/src/default-record-page-save-door.test.ts`) moves to the new text in the same commit. It is changed, not deleted.

**The coupling.** `AppPlugin`'s `private bundle: any` gets a doc comment naming its readers outside the class. I chose this over a public readonly accessor because it is smaller and adds no public surface. Measuring the readers turned up three of them, not the one the card names: `stackDeclaresOrganizationRecordPage` (`@objectstack/core`), the translations check in `@objectstack/cli`'s `serve.ts`, and `graft-runtime-hooks.ts`. The comment names all three.

Changeset: one file, `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` (it ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (the refusal string is in `dist/index.js`) and `@objectstack/runtime`. For runtime I measured the built `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`: both carry the new comment, so the shipped text changes.

## Verification (head `be4b60867`)

- Build: `turbo run build` for spec, metadata-protocol and runtime plus their closure: 31/31 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/default-record-page-save-door.test.ts`: 34/34 passed, run against the rebuilt `metadata-protocol` dist. The old remedy text occurs 0 times in `dist/index.js`, so the moved pin is reading the new string.
- Typecheck for `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/runtime`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts are up to date, `check:docs` included.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 93 families. 92 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a full `pnpm build`), so it was NOT MEASURED locally and CI runs it. `check-engine-split-ratio` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first refused on the shallow clone; after deepening, both exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 92 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- The D3 entry `18.page-default-record-page-one-per-object-refused.ts` already says "compose the deployment without that package's page", which matches the new wording, so it is left as is.
- Nothing about refusals changes: `code`, `status`, `object` and `holders` are the same, and no `.describe()` changed.
